reply_text:
I replied to you in your #north-team thread. I couldn't confirm the tip, and I haven't recorded Elodie Merriwether as the Marrow Agrisupply contact.

I looked through everything you can see yourself: #north-team, #north-random, #inc-qfl-sev1 and the shared files, including the North cheat sheet. None of it mentions Marrow Agrisupply, the Halyard rollout or Elodie Merriwether. That means I can't confirm the tip or rule it out.

One thing to know: I sent the thread reply before I'd finished reading #north-random and #inc-qfl-sev1. Neither one mentions Marrow, so the reply is still accurate.

In the reply I suggested that Dana or Marcus check with the customer if one of them owns the account. I couldn't find who owns Marrow, so I didn't name anyone.
